about_the_game:
Minuto – Galactic Delivery DEMO

Try out 23 of the 62 levels from the full game, including 1 boss battle!
Your progress in the demo is fully compatible with the complete game, so you can transfer your save data and continue your adventure without missing a beat.

short_description: A math-y puzzle game about planning routes to deliver packages in space. All ships must land together while navigating obstacles. Strange customers and hidden lore are there too.
supported_languages: English, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Croatian
